content: Meera Chauhan contacted insurance agent Neha Kapoor to check the status of her auto insurance policy, which was expected to be active by yesterday. Neha confirmed it is still processing and will be active shortly, with a confirmation email to follow. Meera also requested a resend of the policy document, which Neha successfully sent.
